nodes.label: Scope 003 GitHub read only rule: gh may be used for reads (gh api GET, gh run list, gh pr view); no sub session writes to GitHub; main is protected by the branch rule so a change enters only through a pull request with seven passing checks, which is the lead's business

Scope 003 manual steps policy: Docker Desktop, GitHub repo settings, git push, creating or merging PRs, GitHub runner workflows, system tools and anything touching real PostgreSQL or a VM are run only by the user unless the lead forwards explicit permission for one step; a failing docker info makes container steps BLOCKED in verify.md with owner: user; a macOS build is neither Linux nor CI evidence; a failed or flaky step is reported failed, not manual
